charts.title: TOI-5720 b: orbits around TOI-5720
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5720's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5720 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Barkaoui et al. 2024 (2024A&A...687A.264B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname BARKAOUI_ET_AL_2024): P 1.4344555 d

charts.title: TOI-5720 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5720 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (22, 49) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 230055368, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 6 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 9 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 6 min early; 4-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 3 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
